# routeur_budget (Resource)

A spend budget of the organisation, watching the whole organisation or one workspace, project or API key. It alerts by email at a threshold and can optionally make the gateway refuse requests once the cap is exceeded. Requires a routeur.ai plan with budgets to create or change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug = "payments"
  name = "Payments"
}

# $2,000 a month for the whole organisation; alert at 80%.
resource "routeur_budget" "organisation" {
  name         = "Organisation cap"
  scope_type   = "organisation"
  amount_cents = 200000
}

# $500 a week for one workspace, refusing requests once it is exceeded.
resource "routeur_budget" "payments" {
  name         = "Payments weekly"
  scope_type   = "workspace"
  scope_id     = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  period       = "weekly"
  amount_cents = 50000

  alert_threshold_pct = 90
  hard_block          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `amount_cents` (Number) The cap in US cents, 1 to 100,000,000 (for example `50000` is $500.00). Never a decimal.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `scope_type` (String) What the budget watches: `organisation`, `workspace`, `project` or `api_key`. `api_key` budgets alert but cannot be hard-blocked at the gateway. Can be changed in place.

### Optional

- `alert_threshold_pct` (Number) Percentage of the cap, 1 to 100, at which the warning email is sent. Defaults to `80`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is evaluated and enforced. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the budget again.
- `hard_block` (Boolean) When `true` the gateway refuses requests once the cap is exceeded; otherwise the budget only alerts. Defaults to `false`. Applied on the next budgets evaluation pass, not instantly.
- `period` (String) `monthly` (calendar month, UTC) or `weekly` (Monday to Sunday, UTC). Defaults to `monthly`.
- `scope_id` (String) Id of the workspace (`ws_…`), project (`proj_…`) or API key (`key_…`) being watched, in this organisation. Required for every `scope_type` except `organisation`, where it must be omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) Always `USD` today.
- `id` (String) Public id of the budget (`bud_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: the budget id
import {
  to = routeur_budget.organisation
  id = "bud_3"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# the budget id
terraform import routeur_budget.organisation bud_3
```
